title: 第12章 变废为宝
novel_title: 御兽仙朝：我能设计进化形态
content_zh:
转瞬之间，又是一天，悄没声地过去了。

    【筹宝貔】的叫号，已经报到了四千七百名。

    偌大的镜中天地里，一格一格的木柜上，还爬着的兽，满打满算，只剩了三百来只。

    罗影一只一只看过去，识海里那本【万兽衍策】翻得他眼睛都酸了。

    这三百只，无一例外。

    无畏之心，垃圾。

    身子骨，也垃圾。

    是这一窝悍不畏死的【赴死蚁】里头，最末等、最不起眼、被人挑剩到最后的平庸货色。

    罗影心里头清楚。

    按着这书院定下的规矩，垫底的六两银，最后一拨出场。

    等轮到他，柜子里早被人翻拣过千百遍。

    哪怕你生了一双天底下最毒的眼，能一眼相中那最好的兽，可你没银子，排在这最末尾，连个挑的资格都没有。

    即使眼力再好，又有什么用呢？

    好兽，是要紧着出得起价的人先挑的。

    这就是贫穷人的命，早早就写好的剧本。

    除非。

    除非你那双眼，毒到能从旁人都嗤之以鼻的废堆里，捡出一件别人压根瞧不见的宝来。

    化腐朽为神奇。

    变废，为宝。

    而罗影，恰好就有这样一双眼睛。

    他坐在柜子里，身体还很虚，但是他的内心却从未如此平静、安稳。

    他知道那只蚂蚁是属于自己的。

    它就缩在一堆乱七八糟的稻草之下，显得十分虚弱，没有人愿意去瞧它一眼。

    罗影十分笃定。

    这只蚁，绝不亚于第一个出场的蚁，也就是王健砸了一百两挑走的那只。

    甚至，还要犹有过之。

    因为那道青铜色的光柱，比王健那只【赴死蚁】身上的，还要亮。

    而那道光柱后面，则是密密麻麻地排列着无数的光柱，一脉相承，向天际蔓延而去。

    那尽头，是通往【稀有级】？

    还是【异兽级】？

    甚至……是更上头的【奇珍级】？

    罗影心里怦然心动了一下。

    不敢再去往下想。

    那东西离他很远，远到他一个连六两束脩都要拿牛角去换的泥腿子，就连做梦都不敢梦那么高。

    穷人家的孩子最忌讳的就是把希望往天上吊。

    吊得越高，摔得就越凶。

    他只知道一桩事。

    这只蚁的可能性，比王健的要大得多。

    是在这满堂五千只中，独一无二的一只。

    而最妙的，还不在这儿。

    最妙的是，这只蚁，怕死。

    它怕死怕到，宁可缩在草堆里不吃不喝，熬到那将死的极限，才肯探出头来，飞快地拖一口吃食回去。

    它还会装。

    会装残，会装弱，把自个儿那一身的本事，藏得严严实实。

    这一路下来，多少人压根就没瞧见过它。

    便是侥幸瞧见了的，也只当它是一只断了腿、连路都走不利索的废蚁，是这废堆里头，最末等的那一个。

    没人会要它。

    它自个儿，也活生生把自个儿，活成了没人会要的模样。

    所以罗影笃定。

    等轮到他挑的时候，这只蚁，一定还在那儿。

    一定，会是他的。

    就在这时。

    那只【筹宝貔】懒洋洋的声音，终于报到了他的头上。

    “罗影。”
content_en:
In the blink of an eye, another day passed quietly.

Forty-seven hundred people have already registered for the call of [Chiu Bao Pi].

In the huge mirror world, there were dozens of beasts crawling on the wooden cabinets, but only about three hundred were left.

Luo Ying looked at each one one by one, and the book "Education of Ten Thousand Beasts" in the sea of ​​consciousness made his eyes sore.

These three hundred are without exception.

Fearless, garbage.

The bones of the body are also rubbish.

Among this nest of fearless "death-seeking ants", he is the lowest-ranking, most inconspicuous person, the mediocre one who was picked to the last.

Luo Ying knew clearly.

According to the rules set by the academy, the last group of six taels of silver will appear.

By the time it was his turn, the cabinet had been rummaged through thousands of times.

Even if you have the most poisonous eyes in the world and can catch the best beast at a glance, you have no money and are ranked at the bottom, not even qualified to be chosen.

No matter how good your eyesight is, what's the use?

Good animals are picked first by those who can afford them.

This is the fate of poor people, a script written long ago.

unless.

Unless your eyes are so poisonous that you can pick out a treasure that others can't see from the trash heap that others sneer at.

Turn decay into magic.

Turn waste into treasure.

And Luo Ying happened to have such a pair of eyes.

He sat in the cabinet, his body still weak, but his heart had never been so calm and stable.

He knew that the ant belonged to him.

It huddled under a pile of messy straw, looking very weak. No one wanted to take a look at it.

Luo Ying was very sure.

This ant was by no means inferior to the first ant that appeared, the one that Wang Jian smashed a hundred taels and picked away.

Even worse.

Because the bronze light beam was brighter than the one on Wang Jian's [Death Ant].

And behind that light pillar, there are countless light pillars densely arranged, one after another, spreading towards the sky.

At the end, is it leading to [Rare Level]?

Or [Alien Beast Level]?

Or even...a higher [Exquisite Level]?

Luo Ying's heart skipped a beat.

Don't dare to think about it any more.

That thing was very far away from him, so far away that even a six-legged cultivator would have to trade an ox's horn for his clay legs, and he couldn't even dream of being that high.

The most taboo thing for children from poor families is to raise their hopes to the sky.

The higher you hang it, the harder it falls.

He only knows one thing.

The possibility of this ant is much greater than that of Wang Jian.

It is the only one among the five thousand in this hall.

And the best part is not yet here.

The best thing is that this ant is afraid of death.

It was so afraid of death that it would rather huddle in the hay without eating or drinking. It would only stick out its head and quickly take a bite of food after it reached the point of death.

It will also install.

He can pretend to be disabled, he can pretend to be weak, and he can hide all his abilities.

Along the way, many people have never seen it at all.

Even if you were lucky enough to see it, you would just think of it as a useless ant with a broken leg and difficulty walking. It was the last one waiting in this pile of rubbish.

No one will want it.

It itself has also transformed itself into something no one would want.

So Luo Ying was determined.

When it's his turn to pick, the ant will still be there.

It will definitely be his.

Just then.

The lazy voice of the [Cai Bao Pi] finally reached his head.

"Luo Ying."
